EntityCodexEntryDef.label: burrower
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: A shambler that digs down in the ground and ambushes its prey.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: cantor
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: A shambler with glowing eyes and a commanding presence. It heals its own kind and lets out a vile scream that causes nearby foes to flee.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: burster
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: Similar to a boomalope, this shambler spreads chemfuel around itself before violently exploding if in close proximity to an enemy.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: thrasher
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: A shambler that is chemically frenzied, large, and capable of leaps at incredible speed.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: latcher
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: A shambler variant with the mouth of a devourer and a taste for blood.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: gloam
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: A shambler from the void that exploits pinholes to teleport and copy itself.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: tangler
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: A clever variant that uses fleshmass and pollution. It traps victims in fleshy plants and poisons the air with rot stink.

EntityCodexEntryDef.label: pallbearer
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: A shambler that raises the dead during combat.
